description: Smart-Fleet IoT pre-commit safety gates — TanQHoang © 2026

hooks.description: Block commit if a new controller route is added without a docs/api.md entry
Block commit if a new process.env reference exists without a .env.example entry
Block commit if base interval values in maintenanceService.js change without a source comment
Block commit if docker-compose.yml changes without infrastructure/ documentation update
Block commit if console.log appears in backend src/ (use logger service)
hooks.command: grep -rn 'console\.log' backend/src/ && echo 'ERROR: Use logger service instead of console.log' && exit 1 || exit 0
